start: Active workout, Bench Press card with a 1:30 rest, 3 working sets, last time 3x8 at 60 kg

steps.action: Tick set 1
user_sees: The rest timer starts at 1:30
must_not: A rest measured for the first set of the card

steps.action: Wait about 4 minutes, then tick set 2
user_sees: While over, a red '+x:xx over' line under the timer (hidden after 10 minutes)
must_not: The timer stopping by itself without a word

steps.action: Tick set 3 after a normal rest, finish and save the workout
user_sees: The workout saved as usual
must_not: The long rest shown as an error or a warning on the workout

steps.action: Next workout, open the Bench Press card
user_sees: The Target note ends with 'Set 2 came after a long rest, so its goal is not raised.'
must_not: Set 2's extra reps raising its goal
The weight moved up because of set 2
